note: Both sets extract the key parameters (50 deg altitude, 0 deg azimuth, 25 deg bend, 1:1 ratio) but struggle with the complex trigonometric formula, often truncating the 'window azimuth' term or inventing simplified versions. Both sets incorrectly associate the 'average' condition (which applies to spacing reduction) with the structural bend angle. However, Set B additionally misattributes the 'fall equinox at 12pm' condition to the window azimuth (which is 0 due to southern exposure), whereas Set A correctly binds that condition to solar altitude or keeps azimuth conditions accurate. Set A is slightly more faithful regarding conditions.
